# UTS 46 test fixtures

## uts46_vectors.jsonl

Expected UTS 46 results for a corpus of domain names, generated by
script/uts46/generate_vectors.mjs using tr46 v4.1.1 (the reference
JavaScript implementation of UTS 46, Unicode 15.0.0 data) as the
oracle. Only cases whose behavior is identical between Unicode 15.0 and
15.1 are included; Unicode 15.1 additions, ContextO rules, invalid
A-labels and trailing root dots are covered by hand-written examples in
spec/addressable/uts46_spec.rb.

Each line is a JSON array:
[direction, transitional, std3, input, expected] where direction is
"ascii" or "unicode" and expected is the expected output or "ERROR".

## IdnaTestV2.txt (not bundled)

The official Unicode test vectors are not shipped in this repository.
To run them, download the Unicode 15.1.0 version from
https://www.unicode.org/Public/idna/15.1.0/IdnaTestV2.txt and place it
at spec/fixtures/IdnaTestV2.txt; the corresponding example group in
spec/addressable/uts46_spec.rb picks it up automatically.
